paragraphs: Sawatch Labs sells fleet electrification software that uses mile-by-mile predictive analytics to determine EV suitability, cost modeling, infrastructure planning, vehicle management, and emissions reporting. The inputs are individual vehicle telematics data, which fleet managers use as the foundation for making data-driven decisions. Since 2017 the company has supported fleets in all 50 states.

The ezEV analytics use driving data to determine whether an EV would meet a fleet's operational needs. The ezIO analytics project charging load and show how EV charging will impact peak demand at each facility. EMIT lets fleet managers measure vehicle emissions, track progress toward sustainability goals, and generate automated monthly compliance reports from an online dashboard. The ionEV software reports whether EVs are saving money and whether PHEV's are charged and ready every morning.

Testimonials on the site come from public fleets, including an energy engineer for Denver Public Schools and a fleet supervisor with a municipal water district agency. The software is available through Sourcewell Cooperative Purchasing. In May 2024, Sawatch Labs joined WEX. WEX supplies fuel payment transparency, savings, and fraud controls for more than 600,000 fleet customers worldwide.

quote.text: Since 2017, we've been supporting data-driven fleet management, working with fleets around the US and worldwide.
